{{RaceIcon|DireTroll}} [[Dire troll]] | theater = [[Stranglethorn Vale]], [[Zandalar]] | capital = [[Zuldazar]] | leader = {{NPC||Rastakhan||King Rastakhan|icon=ZandalarianTroll Male}} | leaders = {{NPC||Molthor||icon=ZandalarianTroll Male}} | affiliation = Independent | quartermaster = {{NPC||Rin'wosho the Trader||icon=ZandalarianTroll Male}} }} The '''Zandalar Tribe''' is a faction of [[Zandalarian troll]]s, active on [[Yojamba Isle]] with the release of [[Zul'Gurub]]. They came to Yojamba Isle in an effort to recruit help against the resurrected [[Hakkar the Soulflayer|Blood God]] and his [[Atal'ai]] priests in [[Zul'Gurub]] and the [[Temple of Atal'Hakkar]]. ==Background== :''The Zandalarians were the earliest known trolls, the first tribe from which all tribes originated.'' :''Over time two distinct troll empires emerged- the Amani and the Gurubashi. They existed for thousands of years until the coming of the Night Elves, who warred with them and eventually drove both empires into exile.'' :''Following the Sundering, the defeated Gurubashi grew ever more desperate to eek out a living. Searching for a means to survive, they enlisted the aid of the savage Blood God Hakkar, also known as the Soulflayer. Hakkar grew into a merciless oppressor who demanded daily sacrifices from his devotees, and so in time the Gurubashi turned on their dark master. The strongest tribes (including the Zandalar) banded together to defeat Hakkar and his loyal troll priests, the Atal'ai. The united tribes narrowly defeated the Blood God and cast out the Atal'ai... despite their victory, however, the Gurubashi Empire soon fell.'' :''In recent years the exiled Atal'ai priests have discovered that Hakkar's physical form can only be summoned within the ancient and once-deserted capital of the Gurubashi Empire, Zul'Gurub. Unfortunately, the priests have met with success in their quest to call forth Hakkar— reports confirm the presence of the dreaded Soulflayer in the heart of the ruins.'' :''And so the Zandalar tribe has arrived on the shores of Azeroth to battle Hakkar once again. But the Blood God has grown increasingly powerful, bending several tribes to his will and even commanding the avatars of the Primal Gods— Bat, Panther, Tiger, Spider and Snake. With the tribes splintered, the Zandalarians have been forced to recruit champions from Azeroth's varied and disparate races to battle, and hopefully once again defeat, the Soulflayer.''[https://web.archive.org/web/20060218080205/http://www.wow-europe.com/en/info/basics/factions/zandalar/index.html World of Warcraft - Classic Factions - Zandalar Tribe] (Retrieved 18th Feb 2006) ==Reputation== {| class="darktable" style="text-align:center;" !   ! style="{{CSS Reptable Yellowheader}}" | Neutral ! style="{{CSS Reptable Greenheader}}" | Friendly ! style="{{CSS Reptable Greenheader}}" | Honored ! style="{{CSS Reptable Greenheader}}" | Revered ! style="{{CSS Reptable Greenheader}}" | Exalted ! Upgrading the amulet from the Honored version to the Revered version awards 250 rep, as does upgrading the amulet from the Revered to the Exalted version.) ==Rewards== Rewards can be purchased from [[Rin'wosho the Trader]] on [[Yojamba Isle]]. There are also unique head and leg [[Zul'Gurub Enchants]] which require a {{reputation|friendly}} reputation which can be acquired from [[Zanza the Restless]], inside Zul'Gurub. Upon reaching a {{reputation|friendly}} reputation, you can receive a [[Zul'Gurub Amulet|neck slot item]] (as well as some gold and rep), e.g. the [[Maelstrom's Tendril]] from [[Falthir the Sightless]]. You can upgrade these items as your reputation improves. There is also a class-specific [[Zul'Gurub Trinket]] by defeating the 4 [[Edge of Madness]] mini-bosses and collecting each of their quest items. Which of the 4 bosses that spawns is '''not''' random and instead based on a complicated Spawn Calendar. Because of this, it will take a minimum of 1 month for all 4 bosses to spawn. ==Members== ===Named=== * {{NPC||Molthor|icon=ZandalarianTroll Male}} * {{NPC||Jin'rokh the Breaker|icon=DireTroll}} * {{NPC||Al'tabim the All-Seeing|icon=ZandalarianTroll Male}} * {{NPC||Maywiki of Zuldazar|icon=ZandalarianTroll Female}} * {{NPC||Falthir the Sightless|icon=ZandalarianTroll Male}} * {{NPC||Exzhal|icon=ZandalarianTroll Male}} * {{NPC||Rin'wosho the Trader|icon=ZandalarianTroll Male}} * {{NPC||Zanza the Restless|icon=ZandalarianTroll Male}} * {{NPC||Vinchaxa|icon=ZandalarianTroll Male}} ===Unnamed=== * {{NPC||Zandalar Headshrinker|icon=ZandalarianTroll Male|icon2=ZandalarianTroll Female}} * {{NPC||Zandalar Enforcer|icon=ZandalarianTroll Male}} * {{NPC||Zandalarian Emissary|icon=ZandalarianTroll Male|icon2=ZandalarianTroll Female}} * {{NPC||Servant of the Hand|icon=ZandalarianTroll Male|icon2=ZandalarianTroll Female}} ==Patch changes== * [[File:WoWlogo.png|40px]] '''Patch 1.7.0 (2005-09-13):''' Added. ==References== {{Reflist}} ==External links== {{Elinks|faction|270}} {{Factions}} [[Category:Zandalar Tribe| ]] [[Category:Factions]]
